limitations: Only the ordinary integral cup-product ring of smooth complex BIGr(2;2n+1), n >=2; higher k, Chow, equivariant, and quantum ring structures are not determined. Equivalence to an unlocated general linear-section formula remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Uniform characteristic-zero geometric theorem with integral (including modular reduction) ring calculations; independent validation not performed.
title: The integral cohomology ring of the odd biisotropic Grassmannian of lines
